{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Long wool coat, tailored fit, mid-calf length, charcoal grey #36454F, heavy brushed wool.
Merino wool sweater, relaxed but structured cut, crew neck, oatmeal beige #D2B48C, fine-gauge knit.
Dark wash denim trousers, straight leg, ankle length, deep indigo #191970, durable cotton twill with a water-repellent treatment.
Chunky leather Chelsea boots, rounded toe, calf-high shaft, black #000000, waterproof full-grain leather with thick non-slip rubber soles for snowy sidewalks.
This outfit is perfect for your brisk twenty-minute walk through the frost and snow because the outer coat provides essential warmth against the minus ten degree chill while keeping you dry. The dark denim offers durability and a professional yet approachable look suitable for arriving at work, while the textured wool sweater adds a layer of sophisticated comfort under your coat. Finally, the chunky leather boots are specifically chosen to handle slippery, salted roads without compromising style or warmth during your commute."}
